name: Volpack Run-Length Encoded Volume Classification and Storage
definition: A technique for classifying volumetric data and storing it in a run-length encoded (RLE) format optimized for ray casting from three orthogonal viewing axes (X, Y, Z). It processes voxels scanline by scanline, caches classified data, and repacks it into three separate RLE structures at the end of volume processing.
summary: Volpack converts dense voxel grids into axis-aligned RLE structures with classified opacity and shading data to optimize ray casting by skipping transparent regions.
